'''Vice Admiral Renhoff''' is a [[human]] [[quest ender]] located in [[Davenburg]] in [[Stormwind Harbor]] in [[Stormwind City]].

==Quests==
* {{questlong|Alliance|30|The Scales of War}} {{questfinish}}

==Quotes==
===Gossip===
I have been sent on behalf of the Lord Admiral to engage in diplomacy with our southern neighbors.

I have been curious to see if the nobility here are true to [[Alliance of Lordaeron|the old ways]], and to see what respect they hold for the fallen sister kingdoms to the north.

If Kul Tiras and Stormwind are ever to stand side-by-side then brutal truths must be laid out for all to understand bluntly.

There is no truces to be had with the Blackbloods, and no honor to be made standing alongside those that destroyed what once was.

===On-click===
;Greeting
*Kul Tiras sends its regards.
*We defend the vast sea from all who threaten us.
*We do not forget easy in Boralus.
*The Blackblood shall pay for their crimes.

;Farewell
*May the tide be low and the waves calm.
*In the name of the Anchor.
*We shall see where the loyalties of Stormwind truly lie.

;Pissed
*Do you know who you are speaking with?
*I wouldn't push your luck with an admiral.
